title: loam worktree rerun --json
description: runs lists each GitHub Actions run with a failed check: whether its failed jobs run again, or why GitHub did not start them. skipped_checks lists the failed checks that are not jobs of GitHub Actions. Each is [] when none.

id.description: The ID of the GitHub Actions run.

started.description: True when GitHub runs the failed jobs of the run again.

note.description: Why GitHub did not start the run. It is left out when the run started.
